description: Wallet balance and portfolio API for one EVM address on Base and Ethereum: ETH, USDC, WETH, WBTC/cbBTC and DAI holdings with USD value. GET address=0x... (40 hex). Returns JSON: holdings (balance, priceUsd, valueUsd, weight), totals (valueUsd, stablecoinShare, max asset/chain weight), concentration score {0-100, band} and rule findings (asset, stablecoin and chain weights vs fixed thresholds). Read-only; not advice. Invalid addresses return 400, not charged. Price $0.04 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).
